d: The United States and Iran exchange fresh strikes as tensions escalate across the Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz. US fighter jets hit an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island, while Tehran retaliates by targeting American military assets in Kuwait and Bahrain. Saudi Arabia and Qatar call for restraint and diplomacy. Meanwhile, Washington deploys a third aircraft carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, to the region. As both sides issue fresh warnings, diplomatic efforts remain uncertain, and fears of a wider regional conflict grow. Josh Barnes tells you more on Firstpost Live.
